article.title: TikTok Shop獨立App登陸東南亞四個市場
article.title_en: Standalone TikTok Shop app reaches four Southeast Asian markets
article.summary: 據TechCrunch報道，獨立購物App已在新加坡、馬來西亞、泰國和菲律賓提供iOS及Android版本。
article.summary_en: TechCrunch reports iOS and Android availability in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand and the Philippines.
highlights: 用戶仍可透過直播及短片發掘商品。
報道列出的功能包括App內結帳及訂單追蹤。
highlights_en: Shoppers can still discover products via livestreams and short videos.
Reported features include in-app checkout and order tracking.
article.why: 東南亞商戶多了一個讓已有購物意圖的顧客回訪的入口。
article.why_en: Southeast Asian merchants gain a destination that shoppers can revisit with purchase intent.
article.next_step: 按市場檢查商品頁及促銷條款，分開量度內容導流和購物入口流量。
article.next_step_en: Check listings and offer terms by market, and track traffic from content and shopping entry points separately.
article.detail: 獨立App把購物功能集中在一個入口，並保留直播及短片。新加坡App Store由TikTok刊登的商品頁可核對應用及功能描述，四地開放情況則以TechCrunch的直接報道為據。TikTok當時未回覆該媒體的查詢，其他地區的開放時間仍待確認。商戶可先檢查不同入口的商品資料和優惠是否一致。
article.detail_en: The standalone app centres shopping while retaining video and livestream discovery. TikTok’s Singapore App Store listing documents the app and its features. TechCrunch reported the four markets and received no rollout comment from TikTok. Timing for other markets remains unconfirmed.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
